name: Service Mesh TLS Misconfiguration Recovery
description: Validate certificate trust chain, compare service mesh policy changes, inspect sidecar proxy logs, and correct TLS or policy conflicts causing east-west mTLS failures.
steps: Verify The Workload And Issuing Ca Certificate Chain Is Complete And Trusted.
Compare Recent Service Mesh Policy Updates Against The Last Known Working Configuration.
Inspect Sidecar Proxy Logs For TLS Handshake Rejection Details.
Check Handshake Timeout And TLS Settings On Affected Workloads And Mesh Components.
Validate Trust Bundle Distribution Across Namespaces And Workloads.
Correct Conflicting Service Mesh Policy Settings.
Update TLS Configuration If Certificate Chain Or Trust Settings Are Incorrect.
Restart Affected Sidecar Proxies Or Workloads If Configuration Changes Require Reload.
Re-Test East-West Traffic And Confirm Mtls Handshakes Succeed.
